issues.title: Order total is off by a cent on some orders
issues.body: `orders/total.py` sums floats and rounds with `round`, so 3 × 0.35 gives 1.05 on one order and 1.04 on another. Done when the total rounds half up, in Decimal.

issues.title: Export the orders of a month as CSV
issues.body: The shop owner needs the orders of a month as a CSV file: order, customer, total.

issues.title: Dark mode for the admin pages
issues.body: The admin pages have only a light theme.
